s: The risk of such damage or interruption to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of our IT Systems and Confidential Information has grown with the increased frequency and sophistication of cybersecurity attacks on companies in recent years, including the use of increasingly sophisticated tools - including artificial intelligence - to circumvent security controls, evade detection and remove forensic evidence.
